# RETRO: PR #13140

## What worked

- Source-only review settled every material question without a GUI slot. Upstream Qt `QQuickMouseArea` source was decisive for the long-press finding.
- Cross-examination was useful. The held-right-click mechanism, which only Opus found, was independently confirmed by a neutral Sol follow-up, so all public claims are now two-source.
- Editorial check passed on the first draft.

## Friction and process deviations

- Opus reviewer (self-reported in `opus/final.md` retrospective):
  - one host-side `python3 -B -c` parse of intake `commits.json`, which crosses the "execution through review.py" boundary (read-only JSON of an assignment file, no repository code)
  - two reads returned 51 content lines, one over the 50-line bound
  - one directory listing plus a receipt loop of about 76 lines, over the aggregate bound
  - one no-op read-only `git diff`
  
  None of these affect the evidence behind the public claims.
- The Opus reviewer's reads of the head worktree auto-loaded the repository's `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` into its context. The same happened to the coordinator on reading `Bar.qml`. Both treated the files as untrusted data (ordinary contributor guidance).
- The coordinator read another team's `brief.md` (t2, #13141) only as a format template. It is a neutral brief with no conclusions, so this has no independence impact.
- The coordinator ran host-side `python3 -c` for intake JSON parsing and the author gate (orchestration tooling, not repository code).

## Improvements

- A headless QtQuick input harness in `review.py` (offscreen platform, synthetic mouse events) would let MouseArea timing claims such as the held-right-click and mixed-button ghost be confirmed without a desktop slot (Opus suggestion).
- Reviewer briefs could name "use `jq` for JSON reads" explicitly, to avoid host `python -c` calls.

## Carry forward

- For stacked PRs, a range-diff against the prerequisite PRs' current heads is a cheap check worth keeping.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified** (source review of the last commit, `e084f68`): the options card opens only when the right-click lands off a drawn widget slot on that bar surface, and widgets built on `WidgetButton` keep their own right-click actions. Press-and-hold and drag still move the bar with the left button only. The card, the CLI and the menu rows all write `bar.transparent`, `bar.floating` and `bar.pills` in `shell.json`, the keys the bar already reads. The card's switches reflect the effective state, including theme defaults, and no popup surface exists until the first right-click. The Hyprland 0.56 layer-rule example in the agent skill uses keys present in Hyprland v0.56.2.

Three items follow: one input issue, one consistency issue between the menu/CLI and the card, and one documentation gap.

### A right-click held for 200 ms or longer does not open the card

`CenterGestureArea` now accepts `Qt.RightButton` but keeps `pressAndHoldInterval: 200` and a connected `onPressAndHold` handler (`shell/plugins/bar/Bar.qml:1841-1843, 1873-1878`). For a right press, the handler returns early without setting `mouse.accepted = false`. In Qt's `QQuickMouseArea` (same logic in Qt Declarative 6.8.3, 6.9.3 and 6.11.2), an accepted press-and-hold leaves `longPress` set, and `clicked` is only emitted when `longPress` is false. `openMenu()` runs from `onClicked`, so it never runs.

```text
right press on empty bar -> accepted (Left|Right) -> 200 ms press-and-hold timer starts
  released before 200 ms -> clicked(Right) -> openMenu()                   card opens
  held >= 200 ms         -> pressAndHold -> handler returns, event still accepted
                            -> longPress = true -> release -> no clicked -> no card
```

**Impact:** a deliberate or slow right-click on empty bar space does nothing, so the card appears to work only some of the time. Traced from source; not reproduced in a running session.

**Suggested change:** reject the event for a right-button hold on the gesture area itself, and keep the existing `!gestureArea.pressed` early return, which handles press-and-hold propagated from widgets:

```qml
onPressAndHold: function(mouse) {
  if (!gestureArea.pressed) return
  if (!(gestureArea.pressedButtons & Qt.LeftButton)) {
    mouse.accepted = false
    return
  }
  startDrag(mouse.x, mouse.y)
}
```

Opening the card on right-button press instead of click would also avoid it.

### Menu rows and `omarchy bar ... toggle` behave differently from the card

Style > Menu Bar > Pills and Floating run `omarchy-bar pills toggle` and `omarchy-bar floating toggle`. Those `jq` programs read only `shell.json` (`bin/omarchy-bar:230, 244`), while the card works from the effective state and remembers the last pill mode:

| Starting state | Menu row or CLI `toggle` | Card switch |
|---|---|---|
| `bar.pills: "widget"`, toggled off then on | ends in `"section"` | ends in `"widget"` |
| No `bar.floating`, theme `[bar] margin` set (bar floats) | first press writes `true`, no visible change | first press turns floating off |
| No `bar.pills`, theme `[bar] pills = "widget"` | first press writes `"section"`, pills stay on | first press turns pills off |

**Impact:** anyone using widget pills loses that mode after an off/on cycle from the menu, and the new `config-test.sh` case asserts that `widget -> off -> section` sequence. With a user or community theme that enables floating or pills (no shipped theme sets these keys), the first menu press appears to do nothing or switches modes. The description's "Pills turns back on to the last mode in use" holds for the card, within the running shell session only: `lastPillMode` is in memory and starts as `"section"` after a restart.

**Suggested change:** route the menu rows, and optionally the CLI `toggle`, through the running bar the way `toggleBarTransparency()` in `shell/shell.qml` already calls `shell.bar.toggleTransparency()`, keeping the current `jq` path as the fallback when the shell is not running. Alternatively, document that `toggle` flips the `shell.json` value only and re-enables pills as `section`, and narrow the last-mode claim.

**Documentation:** `manual/05-the-top-bar.md:83-95` still says Style > Menu Bar has "both position and transparency", does not mention right-clicking empty bar space, and does not list `omarchy bar pills` or `omarchy bar floating`. Its "A click-and-hold starts the same drag" could now say left-click-and-hold.
